name: pi-fast-jev-compaction
description: Fast, verbatim, jev-guided compaction for pi: keeps old user and assistant text as is and lets TypeSafe's jev model decide which tool calls and outputs to drop. A pi version inspired by the fast-jev-compaction Claude Code plugin.
